blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A joint anti-narcotics operation in Coron, Palawan, led to the arrest of a high-profile drug suspect and the seizure of 7.63 grams of suspected shabu valued at ₱51,884, the Mimaropa police reported. Authorities carried out the operation at 10:40 a.m. on Tuesday at Lambingan Bridge in Barangay Poblacion 2. They served a search warrant issued by the Regional Trial Court, Branch 163, Coron, Palawan, on Oct. 22, in connection with alleged violations of Republic Act No. 9165, or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
